mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_order (order_no, member_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, total_amount, paid_amount, points_used, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_address, status, paid_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{pointsUsed}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, #{status}, #{paidAt})

where.if: AND ( order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR recipient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR recipient_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM mall_order
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM mall_order WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_order WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT * FROM mall_order WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}

mapper.update: UPDATE mall_order SET status = 'SHIPPED', express_company = #{company}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_SHIPMENT'
